Fill in the application form completely and accurately with all requested personal, age, and category details.

important_instructions: This is a public notification only and does not itself constitute an appointment order. Mere submission of the application and fee does not create any entitlement or assurance of appointment; final selection is entirely at the discretion of the appointing authority. Engagement is on a direct-payment/honorarium (Nera Paavati) basis and is temporary in nature - it does not confer any right to regularisation of service or any other employment benefits ordinarily available to regular Pourakarmikas. Wages will be fixed as per the minimum wage notification issued by the Labour Department, revised from time to time, along with ESI and PF benefits. Appointment cannot be made through private contractors - engagement must be direct and cannot be assigned/subcontracted by the appointee to any other individual or organisation. Selected candidates must be in good health; a medical fitness certificate from a registered doctor will be required. No compassionate appointment, pension, gratuity, or similar service benefit is admissible to the family in the event of the appointee's death while on duty. Engaged Pourakarmikas must perform only sanitation-related work and cannot be assigned to any other duties or departments. If an appointee fails in the performance of duty, or if the Chairman/Chief Officer of the local body recommends action, the appointing authority may remove such a candidate from duty without further process. Applicants must not have any pending criminal case and must not have been dismissed from any earlier service on grounds of indiscipline. Selected candidates may be required to furnish a Notary Affidavit undertaking to abide by all rules, orders, and directives issued from time to time by the Government/Department. Furnishing false or incorrect information in the application will lead to rejection of candidature, and may also attract criminal proceedings. The appointing authority (Chairman of the Direct Appointment Authority and Deputy Commissioner, Gadag) reserves the right to cancel or postpone the recruitment process, in part or entirely, at any stage, without assigning any reason. Updates regarding this recruitment will be published on the notice boards of the District Urban Development Cell office, the concerned City Municipal Councils/Town Panchayats across Gadag district (including Gajendragad, Lakshmeshwar, Mundargi, Naragund, Ron, Mulgund, Nargund, and Shirahatti), and on the respective office websites.

content_sections.heading: Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 154 direct-payment Pourakarmika posts are vacant in the Gadag-Betageri City Municipal Council, out of a total sanctioned strength of 308 Pourakarmika posts (calculated as per the norm of 1 post per 700 population, against a 2024 population of 2,09,474). Of the 154 vacant posts, 15 posts (10%) are reserved for eligible legal heirs (spouse, parents, or children) of persons who died under circumstances covered by the Manual Scavengers Act. If suitable applicants are not available under this reservation, these posts will be filled from other categories as per procedure. The notification clarifies that this direct-payment recruitment process does not fall under the Karnataka Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Classes (Reservation) Act, so standard caste-based reservation does not apply to this recruitment in the same manner as regular government recruitment, though the Social Welfare Department's opinion may be sought where relevant.

content_sections.heading: Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is a scrutiny-and-priority-based process (no written examination or interview is conducted): Priority 1: Candidates with at least one year's prior service (before this notification) as Pourakarmika, Loader, UGD (Underground Drainage) Helper, or Cleaner/Helper in the district's local bodies, ranked by seniority in such service. Proof required: ESI/PF salary payment records, bank passbook, or attendance/muster records for the service period. Priority 2: Consideration for family members of Pourakarmikas who died while performing COVID-19 pandemic-related sanitation duty, or who died in service due to other causes. Priority 3: Candidates with at least one year's prior local-body work experience in allied roles - Loaders, UGD Helpers, Cleaners, waste segregation unit workers, or public toilet cleaning staff. Priority 4: 10% of posts reserved for legal heirs (spouse, parents, or children) of persons who died under Manual Scavengers Act-related circumstances. After exhausting eligible candidates under Priorities 1 to 4, any remaining vacant posts may be filled from other applicant categories, following due procedure. If more than one eligible candidate has equal service tenure and equal age, selection among them is done by lottery. Applications are compiled and forwarded by the concerned local body's Chairman/Chief Officer to the District Urban Development Cell and Deputy Commissioner, Gadag; applications sent directly (bypassing the local body) will not be considered. Final selection decision rests with the Chairman of the Direct Appointment Authority and the Deputy Commissioner, Gadag, in consultation with the selection committee.

faq.question: Q1. What is Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the District Urban Development Cell, Gadag, for filling 154 vacant Pourakarmika (Sanitation Worker) posts on a direct-payment/honorarium basis in the Gadag-Betageri City Municipal Council.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: There are 154 total vacant posts, of which 15 posts (10%) are reserved under the Manual Scavengers Act for eligible legal heirs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The last date for application submission is 30.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility for the Pourakarmika post?
faq.answer: No formal educational qualification is required, but candidates must be able to speak Kannada, must be Indian citizens, and must have completed 18 years of age as on the date of the Government notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 50 years of age; no age relaxation is available.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: There is no written exam or interview. Selection is based on a priority system favouring candidates with prior service as Pourakarmika/Loader/UGD Helper/Cleaner in local bodies, seniority in such service, and reservation for legal heirs under the Manual Scavengers Act.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline, using the prescribed form available at the District Urban Development Cell office or the Gadag-Betageri City Municipal Council office, along with the required fee (Demand Draft) and supporting documents, before 30.09.2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. This engagement is on a temporary, direct-payment (honorarium) basis and does not confer any right to regularisation of service or the benefits available to regular employees.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets priority in the Gadag Pourakarmika selection process?
faq.answer: Priority is given to candidates who have worked for at least one year as Pourakarmika, Loader, UGD Helper, or Cleaner in the district's local bodies before this notification, ranked by seniority, followed by candidates from allied sanitation roles and reserved categories under the Manual Scavengers Act.
